### Description

This workshop focuses on nonlinear interaction effects. Various advanced topics are covered. The focus is on interactions with binary and nominal (3 or more category) independent variables. In addition, 3-way interaction effects are discussed. Other miscellaneous issues with interactions effects such as equivalent specifications, sample size and power, multiple comparisons, and group comparisons are considered.
